How do I book?

+

Email myrtlebeachink@yahoo.com or call 843-626-8282 with your idea. For larger projects, or if you want a set date and time, an appointment is recommended.

Can I walk in?

+

Walk-ins are welcome on a first-come, first-served basis. Call ahead to check availability, especially if you are traveling. Please call rather than email for same-day requests.

What styles do you tattoo?

+

The studio takes on all tattoo styles, from small fine-line pieces and custom lettering to portraits, matching tattoos and large-scale work. The artist profiles above show each artist's specialties.

How much will my tattoo cost?

+

It depends on the piece. Share your idea, size and placement, and let the studio know if you have a budget in mind.

What about deposits, ID and other policies?

+

Contact the studio directly for current policies before your appointment.

Our story

A South Carolina
Original.

For over a decade, Myrtle Beach Ink has served locals and visitors in a clean, welcoming, professional environment. It was the first legalized tattoo studio in South Carolina, and it is the officially recognized tattoo shop of Myrtle Beach.

The studio is owned and operated by multi-award-winning artist Eddie Kane, who sets the standard for every piece that leaves the chair. From fine line and custom lettering to portraits, matching tattoos and large-scale custom work, the aim is simple: a tattoo you love and an experience you remember.

Award winner Best of the Beach Year after year.
